description: Translate the Chinese passages remaining in the active knowledge base files: knowledge/episodes.md (16 CJK lines, structured DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS | SUMMARY) and knowledge/rules.md (6 CJK lines, structured `## [keywords]` headings followed by `<priority> <number>. <summary>` entries). These files are READ at every prompt by hooks/feedback/context-enrichment.sh - the SUMMARY content is what gets injected as context when keywords match. The structure is parsed by hook code; only the human-readable SUMMARY text changes.
steps: Inspect knowledge/episodes.md structure: front-matter is non-existent (no `---` block), the file starts with `# Episodes (...)`. Schema HTML comments at the top (`<!-- FORMAT: DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS | SUMMARY -->`, `<!-- STATUS: active / resolved / promoted -->`, `<!-- Promotion candidates ... -->`) are referenced by hook scripts and tests; keep them verbatim or only translate purely human-readable parenthetical bits if any (most are already English/PT-BR).

For each CJK line in knowledge/episodes.md (line numbers from `grep -P -n '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' knowledge/episodes.md`): split on the THREE pipes into 4 columns. Keep DATE, STATUS, KEYWORDS verbatim. Translate ONLY the SUMMARY. Apply the translation rules: keep function names, file names, paths, hook names, identifier names, citation URLs/issue refs, `①` `②` `③`, emoji, English technical phrases, issue numbers, `DO:`/`DON'T:` markers. Convert Chinese punctuation per rules section H. Strikethrough `~~...~~` markup is preserved (translate the contents inside).

Edit knowledge/rules.md: structure is `## [comma,separated,keywords]` heading followed by one or more `🔴 N. <summary>` or `🟡 N. <summary>` lines. Keep the `## [...]` headings AND the priority emoji + number prefix verbatim (these are parsed by distill.sh and context-enrichment.sh per hooks/_lib/distill.sh:53). Translate only the summary text after the `N. ` marker. Same rules: keep identifiers, paths, citations, `①`/`②`/`③`, emoji, English tech phrases.

After editing, verify the schema HTML comments in episodes.md are unchanged: `git diff main -- knowledge/episodes.md | grep '^-<!--' | wc -l` should equal `git diff main -- knowledge/episodes.md | grep '^+<!--' | wc -l` (no schema-comment drift).
Verify zero CJK remains in knowledge/{episodes,rules}.md: `grep -P -l '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' knowledge/episodes.md knowledge/rules.md` returns nothing.

Run pytest and the bash test harnesses; counts must match baseline. The l1-rules-injection.sh and l1-corruption-recall.sh scripts assert against tests/knowledge/fixtures/rules-{healthy,corrupted}.md (NOT against knowledge/rules.md), so this edit cannot regress them.
Stage and commit with message: `docs(i18n): translate knowledge episodes/rules CN -> pt-BR`. git diff --stat HEAD~1 should show only knowledge/episodes.md + knowledge/rules.md.
acceptance_criteria: knowledge/episodes.md and knowledge/rules.md have zero CJK characters.
DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS pipe structure preserved on every line in episodes.md (i.e. each translated line still has exactly 3 unescaped pipes).
All `## [keywords]` headings in rules.md unchanged (verify with `git diff main -- knowledge/rules.md | grep '^[-+]## \['`: should produce balanced `-`/`+` lines or none).
verification: Run `awk -F'|' 'NF>1 && NF!=4 && /^20[0-9][0-9]-/{print NR": "NF" cols: "$0}' knowledge/episodes.md` - prints nothing (every dated line has exactly 4 pipe-separated columns).
Run `git diff main -- knowledge/rules.md | grep -c '^[-+]## \['` - if non-zero, the count of `-## [` lines must equal the count of `+## [` lines (no heading additions/deletions).
Run pytest with the documented ignore set - tail must contain `8 failed, 60 passed`.
Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` - must end with `Results: 27 passed, 1 failed`.
Run `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -10` - must contain `Scripts: 1 pass / 3 total`.
